diagnosis: The provenance checks redundantly guarantee content checks: P1 entails C6 and P2 entails C7 because each repeats the identical commitment predicate. This violates the requirement that no check be automatically guaranteed by another.
evidence: P1 contains the same participation_accommodation predicate required by C6, and P2 contains the same facilitator_selection predicate required by C7.
fix_instructions: Make P1 and P2 test provenance independently of the full commitment content—for example, require the relevant fact IDs in credited_facts, justification_fact_ids, and revealed while leaving the exact commitment requirements solely to C6 and C7.
